scope: Synchronous exact-source Node VM kernel only; no browser AudioContext, scheduler, hardware, xrun, or production five-loop acceptance. Tracks are independent FX instances. Reverse-reverb is an effect, not reverse loop playback; KeepPitch not exercised.
correctness: 512 blocks (65536 frames) per scenario with per-track distinct signal, all output bytes, automation at blocks96/192/224, reset320, silence tail384 onward.
timingQualification: Correctness-only final source gate, intentionally co-loaded with Native wall-clock soak and root correctness; timings must not be used as isolated performance evidence.
